# MDPreview

> MDPreview is a free, instant, 100% private client-side Markdown viewer and real-time live editor. It parses GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) directly in your browser with 0ms server latency, zero telemetry, and syntax highlighting for over 180 programming languages.

## Core Capabilities
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All parsing and rendering execute locally in your browser's V8 engine. Zero text, files, or tokens are transmitted to remote servers.
- **Zero-Latency Real-Time Sync**: Sub-millisecond rendering response with smooth requestAnimationFrame-driven synchronized split-pane scrolling.
- **GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) & KaTeX**: 100% compliant with GFM tables, checklists, fenced code blocks, strikethroughs, and full LaTeX mathematical formula rendering.
- **PDF to Markdown Extraction (PDF to MD)**: Client-side PDF parser that reconstructs document hierarchies, headings (H1-H3), and structured text directly in-browser.
- **Markdown to Social & Knowledge Card (MD to Card)**: Export beautifully styled 2x Retina PNG graphics tailored for Twitter/X, Xiaohongshu, and technical blogs with 6 designer themes.
- **Developer Workflow Features**: One-click HTML export, raw Markdown download, instant clipboard copying, and drag-and-drop file support.
- **Visual Comfort**: Multiple developer themes including GitHub Light, GitHub Dark, Eye-Care Warm Sepia, and Midnight Dark.

## Technical & Architecture Facts
- Architecture: 100% client-side Single Page Application built with Vite and modern ES modules.
- Parsing Engine: Marked.js with GFM extensions and highlight.js (180+ grammars).
- Latency: 0ms network round-trip for editing and previewing.
- Data Storage: Ephemeral browser memory with optional LocalStorage draft preservation.
- Server Telemetry: None. Your document contents never leave your device.
